architecture.fusion: Dynamic Weight Fusion (DWF) gating MLP + 2-class classifier

reported_metrics.note: Figures from project report only — not verified on the shipped checkpoint.

limitations: Untrained weights — scores are not meaningful.
Performance degrades on highly compressed video (CRF > 28).
Audio-only deepfakes not covered when no lip-sync mismatch is present.
Report figures reflect the project evaluation environment, not production.
intended_use: Research and educational demonstration of multimodal deepfake detection.
out_of_scope: Not for use as sole evidence in legal, journalistic or law-enforcement contexts.
